bends.note: north of Liberty Sycamore turns NNE (sheet 157 outline)
Mansfield jogs ~43 px east at Liberty: the street north of Liberty (between 157 outline blocks, ~60 ft wide) is centred ~43 px east of the 30 ft Mansfield south of Liberty, so it has its own T point

notes: Liberty runs WNW-ESE (slope ~0.29). North of Liberty only sheet 157/158 reference outlines are drawn, angled NNE. Liberty is printed 43' near Sycamore and 43'/48' near Broadway, but east of Spring its south line is redrawn on pastes and it is ~60 ft (60' printed near Pendleton), so centreline points there are midway between the main 157/158 outline line and the 153 block fronts (the 157 block between the ~25 ft gap at x~2975 and Cumber is set back ~90 px further north and was ignored). The NNE street north of Liberty ~100 px east of Broadway (40 ft, with water pipe) is not named on this sheet or legibly on the key map (it may be the south end of Drake); written '?'. A narrow (~25 ft) unpiped gap between 157 outline blocks also opens onto Liberty at about x~2975 (projects to ~2930,1462 on the Liberty centreline); not listed as an intersection. Cumber is printed 'CUMBER' here. Mansfield (two T points on Liberty ~43 px apart, see bends) ends at Webster; Webster and Woodward (printed 'WOODWARD (FRANKLIN)', 60 ft) end at Broadway. Dandridge (label printed in the street on the 154 side) meets Pendleton from the east; Schenck Alley (named on sheet 154) meets Pendleton from the east at y~2667-2737. Spring jogs at East 13th: centre ~2827 north (33 ft) and ~2902 south (148 outline, 30 ft), so two T points. East 13th printed 'E. 13TH (WOODWARD)', 40' near Sycamore and 50' near Pendleton. Alleys: the two north-south alleys at x~868 and x~1702 are labelled only 'ALLEY' (unnamed; listed under alleys, split at their Webster crossings); the x~868 alley starts at an E-W 10 ft alley from Sycamore at y~1488 (L-shape); an unnamed 10 ft E-W alley in block 3 joins them at y~2665. RAY ALLEY (10 ft) starts at an unnamed 10 ft E-W alley from Spring at y~1950 and runs to East 13th. Orchard ends at Sycamore from the west (152).
